messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: smart-routing policy anomaly detected for service checkout-api at 2612345678. Symptoms: surge in 5xx from canary variant v2-canary, repeated region fallback between us-west1 <-> eu-west1, customer-facing failures increasing. Paging on-call.

Sam: Oncall grabbing signal. Pulling logs now. @Priya can you open the canary health dashboard?

Priya: Looking — canary v2 shows sustained 503s and high latency. Runtime logs include repeated 'model-variant-mismatch' and 'kv-cache-miss' entries. Not a simple CPU OOM.

Elaine: I can see the routing trace: request -> v2-canary -> fallback -> v1-stable -> session-affinity cookie still points to v2 -> next request goes back to v2 -> fallback again. It looks like affinity is being preserved across fallback which is creating a bounce loop.

Vinh: Confirmed. Policy dump shows `sticky_affinity: true` and `fallback_preserve_affinity: true`. That combination will cause exactly this oscillation when canary is unhealthy. Should be `fallback_preserve_affinity: false`.

Sam: Can we flip that at runtime without a full deploy? What's the config path?

Priya: Route policy is at `route-policies/checkout-api/canary.yaml` in ops-config. Quick mitigation plan: 1) set `fallback_preserve_affinity: false`, 2) reduce canary weight to 0.1, 3) pause rollout. I'll prepare a patch.

Elaine: Also recommend pinning edge to v1-stable for new sessions to stop new users from entering the bounce.

Sam: CS impact call — Asha, any updates from support?

Asha: Seeing a spike in checkout failures from EU tenants. ~2.3% of checkout attempts failing in last 10m, mostly eu-west1. Customers are starting to DM support. I’m drafting an advisory for impacted customers.

Priya: Executing config patch now:

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://ops-api.internal/v1/configs/route-policies/checkout-api" \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"canary":{"weight":0.1,"fallback_preserve_affinity":false},"rollout":{"pause":true}}'
```

OpsBot: :gear: Job 7921 started: apply-config route-policies/checkout-api. ETA ~45s.

Vinh: I'm creating the mitigation runbook entry and assigning SRE and Runtime. Link will be in the incident tracker.

Elaine: Pin edge to stable variant (forcing new sessions to v1):

```bash
redwood route pin --service checkout-api --variant v1-stable --scope edge
```

Sam: Pinned edge to v1-stable. Verified header traces show new requests landing on v1.

Priya: Ops job finished — config updated. Canary weight reduced to 0.1, `fallback_preserve_affinity=false`, rollout paused.

IncidentBot: Please acknowledge when mitigations are observed and customer impact is reducing.

Sam: Acknowledged. Watching metrics for 15m.

Priya: Error rates dropping. 5xx in eu-west1 back to baseline in ~7m after the patch. Latency normalized.

Asha: CS update: initial advisory sent to affected customers, triage tickets created. No major escalations so far.

Vinh: I'll set severity to P2 and open a postmortem. Add action items: default fallback PRESERVE_AFFINITY should be false for canary flows; add CI smoke test that simulates fallback and asserts affinity cleared; and add guardrail to prevent canary rollouts with `fallback_preserve_affinity: true` unless explicitly approved.

Elaine: Also proposing an automated breaker: if fallback loops > 3 in 60s, auto-pause rollout and send pager.

Priya: Adding a test in the runtime repo to simulate variant mismatch + fallback and assert no affinity cookie is preserved across fallback.

Sam: Good. I'll own the post-incident follow-up and RFC for changing the default. Assigning owners in the runbook.

IncidentBot: Incident annotated: mitigation applied, monitoring ongoing.

Sam: :thumbsup: Closing oncall for now. We'll reconvene for postmortem timeline and retro.

Vinh: Filing incident report and linking runbook + logs.

Elaine: Thanks team. Nice quick response.

Priya: Leaving a comment in the canary dashboard with the timeline and config diff.

Sam: Thread will remain open until postmortem published. If anyone spots re-oscillation ping here immediately. :eyes:
